title: NLCS Game 4 Highlights: World Series Bound! Brewers Sweep Dodgers
text:
Follow along for the moments and highlights of Game 4 of the NLCS between the Brewers and Dodgers.
The two-time defending World Series champions are out, and the Brewers are heading to their first Fall Classic in 44 years! The Brewers looked like an absolute machine throughout the NLCS against the Dodgers, sweeping them in four games.
In each game, the Brewers had to come back, and in each game they were able to come out on top. Game 1 of the World Series will be next Friday, Oct 23. , in Milwaukee against either the Guardians or Rays. MLB Moves Start Time Of Brewers-Dodgers NLCS Game 4Jake Bauers Nearly Retired.
